def solve(data):
    packages = data['packages']
    roots = data['roots']
    names = sorted(packages)
    required = set(roots)
    best_versions = None
    best_score = None

    def search(chosen, needed):
        nonlocal best_versions, best_score
        pending = needed - chosen.keys()
        if not pending:
            score = tuple(chosen[name] if name in chosen else -1 for name in names)
            if best_score is None or score > best_score:
                best_score = score
                best_versions = dict(chosen)
            return

        name = min(pending)
        if name not in packages:
            return
        rows = packages[name]
        if name in roots:
            lower, upper = roots[name]
            rows = [row for row in rows if lower <= row['version'] <= upper]

        for row in rows:
            version = row['version']
            deps = row['deps']
            next_chosen = dict(chosen)
            next_chosen[name] = version
            search(next_chosen, needed | set(deps))

    search({}, required)
    if best_versions is None:
        raise ValueError('no feasible installation')
    return {'versions': best_versions}
